title: [Suite autour de Teichmüller dont] Teichmülleries, 1981-1982 : notes manuscrites (1981-1983, s.d.), lettres (1981, s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This is a working page on the base of the Teichmüller tower: π_{0,3} = π_1(P^1−{0,1,∞}), its finite covers, and its extensions by the symmetric group S_3 that are related to (P)SL(2,Z). The reading below is a best guess.

(1) Top-left block. Four loops λ_0, λ_{1/2}, λ_1, λ_∞ are defined in π_{0,3} = <l_0,l_1,l_∞ | l_0 l_1 l_∞ = 1>:
- λ_0 = l_0^{-1} l_1 l_0
- λ_{1/2} = l_0^2
- λ_1 = l_1
- λ_∞ = l_∞^2
They lie in the index-2 subgroup that is the kernel of the map π_{0,3} → Z/2 with l_0, l_∞ ↦ 1 and l_1 ↦ 0. That subgroup is the fundamental group of the double cover branched over 0 and ∞, a sphere with four punctures, i.e. a copy of π_{0,4}. The assignment λ_0 ↦ l_1, λ_{1/2} ↦ l_∞, λ_1 ↦ l_0, λ_∞ ↦ 1 then fills in one puncture, giving a homomorphism from this π_{0,4} back to π_{0,3}. This is the standard way covering-and-forgetting maps between the levels of the Teichmüller tower produce endomorphisms and relations.

(2) Top-right block. The assignment l_0 ↦ ε_∞, l_1 ↦ l_0, l_∞ ↦ σ_∞ lands in a semidirect extension π_{0,3}·{1,σ_∞}, where σ_∞ is an involution (the symmetry fixing ∞ and swapping 0 and 1). The two inversion computations, (l_1 ε)^{-1} = σ_∞ ρ^{-1} and (l_0 ε)^{-1} = σ_∞, use ρ, the order-3 rotation 0→1→∞. So he is computing in π_{0,3} ⋊ S_3, where S_3 = <ρ, σ_∞>. The aim is a homomorphism ψ̂_∞ : π̂_{0,3} → π̂_{0,3}·{1,σ_∞} between profinite completions, i.e. an orbifold covering map involving a point of order 2.

(3) Middle block. He identifies the relevant groups with congruence data:
- PSL(2,Z) ⊃ Γ(2)/±1 ≅ π_{0,3}, with quotient SL(2,Z/2) ≅ S_3, so 𝔊^+_{0,3} is presumably the orientation-preserving extension π_{0,3}⋊S_3, i.e. PSL(2,Z) up to completion.
- The written line is Sl(2,Ẑ)' → Sl(2,Z/2) → 1.
- By the Chinese remainder theorem SL(2,Z/12) splits over Z/4 and Z/3; level 12 is relevant because SL(2,Z)^{ab} = Z/12.
- 𝔖_3 ≅ SL(2,Z/2).

(4) Struck-out bottom block. For pairs (c,d) mod 3 he computes D = c^2 + cd + d^2, the Eisenstein norm form. Its values lie in {0,1} mod 3 and he excludes 0. This is likely related to the j=0 / order-3 symmetry, i.e. the commutator subgroup of SL(2,Z) as π_1 of the punctured elliptic curve with j = 0. It is struck through with "!!!", suggesting he abandoned it or found it beside the point.

Overall: routine group-theoretic bookkeeping toward describing the action of the Grothendieck–Teichmüller / Galois group on π̂_{0,3} together with its S_3-symmetric and 2-cover variants.
errors: By CRT, SL(2,Z/12) ≅ SL(2,Z/4)×SL(2,Z/3) directly; quotienting by the diagonal ±1 gives PSL(2,Z/12). The formula with '/±1' is correct only if the prime/notation means the projective group (or some specific image), which the page does not make clear.

The line Sl(2,Ẑ)' → Sl(2,Z/2) → 1 is ambiguous: if ' means commutator subgroup, the image in SL(2,Z/2) ≅ S_3 would be its commutator subgroup A_3, not all of S_3. Notation is unclear rather than certainly wrong.
The bottom computation is struck out by the author (with '!!!'), indicating he considered it erroneous or irrelevant.

ideas.what: Index-2 subgroup of π_{0,3} (double cover branched at 0, ∞) identified with π_{0,4}, followed by a puncture-filling map back to π_{0,3}
ideas.modern_name: Covering/forgetful maps between levels of the Teichmüller tower; 'duplication' relations in GT theory

ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme discusses the tower and its covers in general terms

ideas.modern_name: Orbifold fundamental group of M_{0,4}/S_3 ~ PSL(2,Z) (or PGL(2,Z)); principal congruence subgroup Γ(2)

ideas.what: Extension of a homomorphism to the profinite semidirect product π̂_{0,3}·{1,σ_∞}
ideas.modern_name: Action of GT / Gal(Q̄/Q) on the profinite orbifold fundamental group with an order-2 point

ideas.what: SL(2,Z/12) decomposition via CRT and the abelianization Z/12 of SL(2,Z)
ideas.modern_name: Congruence quotients of SL(2,Z); commutator subgroup of index 12

deep.surprise_reason: Scratch computations relating π_{0,3}, its index-2 cover, S_3-extensions and congruence quotients of SL(2,Z). This is standard background for the Teichmüller-tower / GT programme, now well documented in the literature; there is no new result, and the only non-trivial attempt is struck out.
transcription_corrections: 'λ_∞ = l_∞^2 ⟼ φ': the target is most likely '1' (the trivial element), not φ.
In the two inversion lines the subscript read 'ε_0' may be 'ε_∞' (consistent with l_0 ↦ ε_∞); the image is ambiguous.
The struck-out block computes D = c^2 + cd + d^2 for c ≡ 0, 1, −1 mod 3. 'o exclus' means '0 exclu' (zero excluded), and the second case reads D = 1 + d^2 + d ∈ {1,0}.
'Sl(2,12)'' is presumably SL(2,Z/12); the 'ℤ/[?]' under Sl(2,Ẑ)' is probably a '∪' / '≃' symbol over 𝔊̂^+_{0,3}.
